decisions_requested.statement: Approve this as a scoped L02 course pattern candidate for the city/place intent only; PARI remains WATCH and no generic transitive syntax is established.
Approve direct reuse of validated L01-OPI-005 for L02 work-place questioning, without expanding KUVAN into universal locative grammar.
Approve analogical substitution of WATCH PARAZAMI into the validated locative frame for scoped L02 use only.
Approve the scoped content-question analogy while keeping KU as a non-universal content selector and PARAZAMI WATCH.
Approve the scoped work-content analogy without redefining VALI as a generic activity noun or making KU globally productive.
Approve this only as a high-risk scoped yes/no course hypothesis; SAROSARI remains WATCH and bare-predicate question grammar is not generalized.
Approve the controlled perception pattern for L02 only, without creating universal transitivity.
Approve only as a very-high-risk scoped hypothesis using PA as a lexical past-time anchor; do not infer tense morphology, sentence-initial temporal grammar, or a productive past system.
Approve the controlled loanword-perception pattern without generalizing borrowing or food morphology.
Approve this sequence only as an integrated OPI card; the sequence does not establish discourse grammar.
Approve the evidence classes and risk labels as course-governance metadata only; they do not change language authority.
Require G-ID expansion through @hnk/glyphs only after this pattern gate is explicitly approved and before any L02 OPI curriculum slot becomes AUTHORED.
Confirm that approval of these patterns would not establish universal HNK word order, tense, transitivity, interrogative or discourse grammar.
